_readme: Edit this file and upload it to change events, the weekly schedule and links — no build, no deploy. Upload with: node scripts/upload-media.mjs ./content content

schedule.name: Guild Party
schedule.description: Daily guild gathering. Everyone logs in, shares tea, and banks the day's rewards together.

schedule.name: Breaking Army & Showdown
schedule.description: Boss clears and Guild Arena PvPs. Two runs every week, Wednesday and Saturday at 9:30pm.

schedule.name: Guild Heroes Realm / Normal Heroes Realm
schedule.description: Weekly Heroes Realm clear on Monday, with a second run on Friday straight after Guild Party.

schedule.name: Guild vs Guild
schedule.description: Guild vs Guild - 4 runs total weekly.
